notes.title: Dualis. Episode 2 — Release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I'm happy to announce that Episode Two of Dualis is officially out and now available on Steam.
If you’ve been waiting for the story to continue — it’s here.

A quick reminder for those who might be new to the project:
Dualis is a story-driven horror thriller that combines stealth-action and survival horror elements, presented from an isometric perspective.
The game is released in episodes and is currently in Early Access. A total of three episodes are planned. The first is already available — and now it’s joined by the second.

What to expect in Episode Two:
• Two new locations — larger in scale and more visually diverse
• Story progression — a faster pace and more dynamic narrative development
• New enemy types and logic-based challenges
• The first boss fight in the game
• On average, 40–60 minutes of gameplay per chapter (depending on playstyle)

What’s been improved:
In addition to the new content, several improvements have been made to Episode One:
• Performance optimizations (FPS in previously heavy scenes increased to 80–120)
• Rebalanced difficulty, especially in the final section
• Bug fixes and an updated save system

Dualis is an independent project that I’m doing my best to bring to completion.
Thank you to everyone who’s stayed with it — your interest is the main reason this game keeps moving forward. If you've already played Episode One — I hope the second chapter lives up to your expectations. If not — now’s a great time to dive in. Add Dualis to your wishlist, share your thoughts, and as always, thank you for your support.

notes.title: Auto-aiming update
notes.notes: Many players have reported difficulty in controlling when shooting a gun or fighting with a knife. This update adds auto-aiming to the game. This update should make the gameplay more friendly. You will be able to turn auto aiming off or on in the gameplay settings.
